name: FrenchModelVariant857_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/image103128_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (four emitters fire projectiles from four model parts with impact flares); for a non-negative request it selects the ten-byte configuration indexed by the request and packs two textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-image103128-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-840/937 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant840_entry.c, which selects burst CLUT row 0x3D20, at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
